text:
incident-bot: <INCIDENT> gateway error spike detected for api.redwood.ai — 502/504 error rate 18% over 2m (threshold 5%). Pager: @paul_sre. Automatic mitigation suggestions queued.

paul_sre: ack, picking this up. any known deploys in last 30m? customer impact known?

li_chen: seeing lots of upstream resets and long connect times in edge-proxy logs. prob 504s. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/edge/gateway?range=2m

maria_prod: CS telemetry shows 3 EU customers with high failure rates and requests timing out. they're seeing 50% of requests fail on some routes. CS already alerted customers.

paul_sre: running quick cluster health checks.

```
$ kubectl get pods -n gateway
NAME           READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
gw-front-0     1/1     Running            0          23m
gw-front-1     1/1     Running            0          10m
gw-proxy-0     0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   5          2m
```

jonathan_runtime: pulling logs from gw-proxy-0 now. seeing repeated: 

```
[2026-03-14T12:34:50Z] ERROR upstream reset by peer svc-model-2 id=0x7f: connection reset
[2026-03-14T12:34:51Z] WARN request timeout after 30s
[2026-03-14T12:34:52Z] ERROR failed to allocate buffer: out of memory
```
looks like node memory pressure plus upstream timeouts.

paul_sre: do we have a recent canary or config tweak on connection keepalive/pool?

jonathan_runtime: we rolled a small keepalive tweak 12:20 on gw-proxy (canary): lowered backend keepalive to 30s to free sockets. might be related.

maria_prod: CS: impacted customers are EU-fintech-1, EU-marketing-2, EU-saasmid. They want ETA.

paul_sre: mitigation plan (short): 1) scale gw-proxy replicas +2 now, 2) cordon/drain node n4 if memory pressure, 3) temporarily enable legacy-route fallback for heavy routes, 4) if no improvement in 2-3m rollback keepalive change.

li_chen: scaling now -> `kubectl scale deployment/gw-proxy --replicas=4 -n gateway` (executed).

incident-bot: action recorded: gw-proxy scaled to 4 replicas by li_chen at 1925012360.

jonathan_runtime: monitoring — new pods coming up, but still seeing upstream resets; error rate down to ~9% (was 18%). CPU/mem on node n4 still high.

paul_sre: applying temporary rate-limit on heavy inference route: `edge.rate-limit=100rps` for /v1/generate. should reduce backend pressure. Applying now.

jonathan_runtime: cordoned node n4 and started drain: `kubectl cordon n4 && kubectl drain n4 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — some pods rescheduled to other nodes. Node shows memory pressure in kubelet events.

maria_prod: CS drafting customer update: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors in EU; mitigation in progress; next update in 30m."

nikita_support: posted initial status page: "Investigating increased error rate in EU gateway; mitigation underway." link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1925012345

jonathan_runtime: after scaling + drain, error rate now ~2.5% and tail latency back to normal percentiles. still keeping rate-limit active for 15m.

paul_sre: good. rolling back canary to be safe. `kubectl rollout undo deployment/gw-proxy -n gateway --to-revision=3` (triggered).

incident-bot: incident marked mitigated (auto-check) at 1925012440. moving to postmortem queue: #incidents-postmortem.

paul_sre: oncall handoff: @li_chen please take the night watch and own the postmortem. I'll assemble timeline and initial notes.

li_chen: taking handoff. actions for postmortem: investigate keepalive change impact, autoscaler thresholds, node memory pressure. add more aggressive burst autoscaling for gateway. :thumbsup:

nikita_support: CS will follow up with affected customers with a detailed note and share call logs.

paul_sre: thanks everyone. I'll write the initial postmortem draft and link logs/graphs in #incidents-postmortem.

li_chen: got it, will follow up tonight if anything regresses.

nikita_support: closing loop on customer comms once postmortem ready.
